title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
titleZh: Muse Glimmer：针对始终在线的本地代理工作流程优化的 30B 参数模型
author: riordan
relevanceReason: 命中 5 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Today, we're introducing Muse Glimmer, the next model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, and open sourcing the model weights under a permissive Apache 2.0 license. Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows. It’s small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU, enabling use cases that range from local agents and function calling, to local coding, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Muse Glimmer delivers strong performance on key agentic use cases and benchmarks compared with leading models in its size category. Foundation models have achieved remarkable capabilities across reasoning, code generation, and tool use — yet most deployments still depend on cloud infrastructure and network access. Running models locally enables you to use AI anywhere, anytime, with or without an internet connection. This is increasingly viable: the open source community has shown that smaller models, when trained effectively, can approach frontier-level performance on targeted tasks. Muse Glimmer is optimized for these local use cases. Keeping with our long tradition of sharing fundamental AI research, we're releasing Muse Glimmer open weights today on Hugging Face, along with developer documentation to help you start building and running your own agents. Muse Glimmer is built to work with the tools developers already use. Optimized integrations on llama.cpp, MLX, and ExecuTorch will land in the coming days, so you can go from download to working agent in minutes. How We Trained Muse Glimmer An agent that manages your schedule, drafts your messages, organizes your files, and learns how you work needs deep access to personal context. It also needs several capabilities working in concert: long-horizon execution, precise tool calling, multimodal understanding, long-context memory, and instruction following. We designed Muse Glimmer to balance capability against the memory and compute constraints of local hardware. This required a compact architecture, a novel distillation recipe that transfers agentic reasoning from a much larger teacher model, and inference optimizations — including quantization — to meet latency expectations. We achieved this in the following phases:

Pre-Training. We trained Muse Glimmer on Muse Spark's outputs using logit distillation, leveraging a similar data mix as the teacher. Mid-Training. We trained the model on longer-context, more agent-heavy data with richer reasoning traces, alongside organic data. Post-Training. We combined supervised fine-tuning with a mix of on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning across general, reasoning, coding, and agentic domains.

Muse Glimmer was evaluated under the standards set out in Meta's Advanced AI Scaling Framework and assessed for open-weight release across all relevant categories. Built for Agents: What Muse Glimmer Can Do Building effective agents requires key capabilities working together to achieve the user’s goals. Muse Glimmer is trained and evaluated across each of the following:

End-to-end Agentic Task Completion. Muse Glimmer achieves strong success rates on full-task benchmarks including DeepSearch QA, MCP-Atlas, 𝛕-Bench and SWE-Bench, which measure its ability to work within scaffolds, write and debug code, and resolve multi-turn requests from start to finish. Reliable Tool Use. The model handles a wide range of function calls, invoking tools with precise schemas throughout extended workflows. Multi-Step Reasoning. Muse Glimmer chains reasoning over long horizons, sustaining coherent plans across complex, extended workflows. Failure Recovery. When a tool call fails or returns an unexpected result, the model is trained to diagnose the error and retry rather than halt. Multimodal Input and Reasoning. Through a dedicated perception encoder, the model accepts interleaved text and images. This enables agents to interpret screenshots, charts, and documents alongside conversation. Scaffold Compatibility. Muse Glimmer works across OpenClaw and other agentic orchestration patterns. Controllable Effort. Muse Glimmer supports different reasoning strengths to select the right balance between quality and speed. Multilingual. Muse Glimmer is trained on data from more than 100 languages.

Performance We evaluated Muse Glimmer across a broad range of benchmarks to assess the diverse capabilities required for effective autonomous agent behavior. Compared with Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B, Muse Glimmer performs strongly for its size class on several widely used LLM benchmarks.

children.author: pu_pe
children.textRawHtml: Based on the benchmarks, it seems that Muse Glimmer barely edges out against Qwen3.6 27B, except for tool-calling skills (MCP, etc.). I wouldn't be surprised if they released it now because they are afraid they wouldn't beat Qwen3.8 27B.
children.textZhHtml: 根据基准测试，除了工具调用技能（MCP 等）之外，Muse Glimmer 似乎与 Qwen3.6 27B 几乎没有什么优势。如果他们现在发布它我不会感到惊讶，因为他们担心无法击败 Qwen3.8 27B。

children.author: dofm
children.textRawHtml:
I am glad they released it because I think we need a competitive culture of open weights that isn't just geopolitics.

But I have to say, I quite like the way Muse Glimmer thinks and talks. It's a cocky bastard in tone, but it's quite good, and its thinking traces are relatively terse.
children.textZhHtml:
我很高兴他们发布了它，因为我认为我们需要一种开放权重的竞争文化，而不仅仅是地缘政治。

但我不得不说，我非常喜欢 Muse Glimmer 思考和交谈的方式。语气是个牛逼，不过还不错，思维痕迹也比较简洁。

children.author: mycall
children.textRawHtml: Do AI companies make release plans based on upcoming other models like this?  I would think all the processes that go into the repository and weight infrastructure pre-training, checkpointing, knowledge distillation, model compression, post training pipeline, ecosystem integrations, inference API, benchmarking, human eval/safety/alignment, docs, etc... all that dictates the release schedule.
children.textZhHtml: 人工智能公司是否会根据即将推出的其他类似模型制定发布计划？  我认为进入存储库和权重基础设施预训练、检查点、知识蒸馏、模型压缩、训练后管道、生态系统集成、推理 API、基准测试、人类评估/安全/对齐、文档等的所有流程......所有这些都决定了发布时间表。

children.author: drob518
children.textRawHtml: Any company working in a competitive industry is generally aware of what their competitors are doing. PR is an important aspect to market success, so it factors into release schedule. It may not be the dominant factor given engineering constraints, but yea, it’s certainly a factor, and a large one at that.
children.textZhHtml: 任何在竞争激烈的行业中工作的公司通常都知道竞争对手在做什么。公关是市场成功的一个重要方面，因此它会影响发布时间表。考虑到工程限制，它可能不是主导因素，但是，是的，它肯定是一个因素，而且是一个很大的因素。

children.author: echelon
children.textRawHtml:
There has been a long history of AI model releases made shortly before or after a major planned release by another company. Almost always to upstage or steal thunder.

Just recently, Minimax H3 released as open weights on the eve of Seedance 2.5 global availability. It's not as good, but it's good enough and it's completely open.

Flux 3, which is nowhere near as good as either, suddenly announced their release once news of these other two became public. They knew if they waited they'd be ignored. It didn't really help them much, unfortunately.

The LLM releases are even more rivalrous.

And don't forget all of the competing launches planned before Google IO or major release events.

Companies like to eat into the news and press cycle of their rivals.
children.textZhHtml:
在另一家公司计划发布重大版本之前或之后不久发布人工智能模型的历史由来已久。几乎总是为了抢风头或抢风头。

就在最近，Minimax H3 在 Seedance 2.5 全球上市前夕作为开放重量发布。虽然没有那么好，但已经足够好了，而且是完全开放的。

Flux 3 远不及其中任何一个，但在其他两个的消息公开后突然宣布发布。他们知道，如果他们等待，他们就会被忽视。不幸的是，这并没有给他们带来多大帮助。

LLM 版本的竞争更加激烈。

并且不要忘记在 Google IO 或重大发布活动之前计划的所有竞争发布。

公司喜欢蚕食竞争对手的新闻和新闻周期。

children.author: vunderba
children.textRawHtml:
BFL is in a rough spot here too. It’s pretty much looking like a repeat of the exact same situation they had when they released Flux2 at the same time Z Image Turbo came out and completely overshadowed their launch.

Minimax H3 can run exceptionally fast (10 minutes for a 15 second 0.5mp video and that's stock cuda 13), works on 16 GB VRAM GPUs, etc. If Flux3 is anything like Flux2, it’s going to require an absolute monster truck of a machine and still run significantly slower. Even if it’s a better model, that won’t matter as much if nobody releases any LoRAs or fine-tunes for it.

Not to mention BFL licensing often feels deceptively confusing and restrictive.
children.textZhHtml:
BFL 在这里也遇到了困难。这看起来就像是他们发布 Flux2 时遇到的完全相同的情况，同时 Z Image Turbo 出现，并完全掩盖了他们的发布。

Minimax H3 可以运行得非常快（15 秒 0.5mp 视频需要 10 分钟，这是库存的 cuda 13），可以在 16 GB VRAM GPU 上运行，等等。如果 Flux3 与 Flux2 类似，那么它将需要一台绝对怪物卡车的机器，并且运行速度仍然明显慢一些。即使它是一个更好的模型，如果没有人发布任何 LoRA 或对其进行微调，那就没有那么重要了。

更不用说 BFL 许可常常让人感觉令人困惑和限制。

children.textRawHtml: I've seen it here on HN (it's particularly noticeable via the /active page) multiple times. If Google, OpenAI or Anthropic release something significant, odds are good you'll see a headline from one of the others.

children.author: michimagdesign
children.textRawHtml: Yes, not every model release is reactionary to other labs. Either they had hints for the release of other models or they cut efforts in late stage testing of the models to hit these earlier release dates. There’s always some flexibility. And there’s certainly the incentive to cannibalize the news cycles for competitor models.
children.textZhHtml: 是的，并非每个模型发布都会对其他实验室做出反应。他们要么暗示要发布其他模型，要么削减模型后期测试的工作量以适应较早的发布日期。总是有一定的灵活性。而且肯定有动机蚕食竞争对手模型的新闻周期。

children.textRawHtml: Yeah but you can probably have everything ready and then accelerate as necessary. Meta itself did this when releasing Llama 4, it was a really botched release right when they were feeling the heat from DeepSeek and others.
children.textZhHtml: 是的，但是您可能可以准备好一切，然后根据需要加速。 Meta 自己在发布 Llama 4 时就这样做了，当他们感受到 DeepSeek 和其他人的热度时，这是一个非常糟糕的版本。

children.author: overfeed
children.textRawHtml:
> ...all that dictates the release schedule.

AI companies release models when they are ready - not on a set schedule. The steps are required to produce a release candidate, so a company can choose to bless the RC with the best metrics at any time - or alternatively continue (post/)training newer RCs if they feel they can do better, and they have time. When a model is ready for release is subjective, and can take into consideration what the competition is doing.

An obvious counter-example to schedules driving releases is the still unreleased Gemini 3.6 Pro.
children.textZhHtml:
> ...所有这些都决定了发布时间表。

人工智能公司在模型准备就绪时发布模型 - 而不是按照设定的时间表。生成候选版本需要这些步骤，因此公司可以选择随时为 RC 提供最佳指标，或者如果他们认为自己可以做得更好并且有时间，则继续（后/）培训新的 RC。模型何时准备好发布是主观的，可以考虑竞争对手正在做什么。

计划推动发布的一个明显的反例是尚未发布的 Gemini 3.6 Pro。

children.author: stogot
children.textRawHtml: the last few items there (benchmarking, human evaluation, docs) can be rushed or skipped by leadership if they want to beat comp. they probably spend a few weeks on those things normally
children.textZhHtml: 如果领导层想要击败竞争对手，他们可以匆忙或跳过最后几项（基准测试、人工评估、文档）。他们通常可能会花几周的时间在这些事情上

children.author: dannyw
children.textRawHtml: One window that can be shortened is working with software ecosystem and upstream partners; think day 0 on together, fireworks, Unsloth, etc. That obviously happens from partners getting embargoed weights early.
children.textZhHtml: 一个可以缩短的窗口是与软件生态系统和上游合作伙伴的合作；一起思考第 0 天，烟花，不懒惰等等。这显然是由于合作伙伴过早获得禁运重量而发生的。

children.author: kolbe
children.textRawHtml: Qwen3.6 27B is the go-to medium sized model for coding, so beating it is not a small achievement
children.textZhHtml: Qwen3.6 27B 是编码的首选中型型号，因此击败它并不是一个小成就
